US Judge Orders Processing of Diversity Visa Applications

A federal judge has ordered the reopening of the diversity visa lottery for 2027, allowing up to 55,000 applicants. The ruling mandates a 30-day registration period for submissions. This decision follows a lawsuit filed against Secretary of State Marco Rubio concerning the lottery's registration process. Separately, H-1B and green card applicants in the US may face extended waiting times due to a review of premium processing rules.
